```typescript
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { UserRole, OrganizationType } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';
import { emailService } from './email.service';

export interface RegisterInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
  organizationName?: string;
  organizationType?: OrganizationType | 'warehouse' | 'carrier' | 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR' | 'CARRIER';
  role?: UserRole;
  organizationId?: number;
}

export interface LoginInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
}

export interface ForgotPasswordInput {
  email: string;
}

export interface ResetPasswordInput {
  token: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

export interface ChangePasswordInput {
  email: string;
  oldPassword: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

export interface ResendVerificationInput {
  email?: string;
  userId?: number;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  token: string;
  user: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    role: UserRole;
    organizationId: number;
    isEmailVerified: boolean;
    organization?: {
      id: number;
      name: string;
      type: OrganizationType;
    };
  };
}

export class AuthService {
  /**
   * Helper to issue a signed JWT token containing user ID, organization ID, and role.
   */
  public generateToken(user: { id: number; organizationId: number; role: UserRole; email: string }): string {
    return jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: user.id,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        role: user.role,
        email: user.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn as any }
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parse and normalize organization type string to Prisma OrganizationType enum.
   */
  private normalizeOrganizationType(type?: string): OrganizationType {
    if (!type) {
      throw {
        status: 400,
        message: 'organizationType is required and must be either "WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR" (warehouse) or "CARRIER" (carrier).',
      };
    }

    const upper = type.toUpperCase().trim();
    if (upper === 'WAREHOUSE' || upper === 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR') {
      return OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR;
    }
    if (upper === 'CARRIER') {
      return OrganizationType.CARRIER;
    }

    throw {
      status: 400,
      message: 'Invalid organizationType. Must be either "WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR" (warehouse) or "CARRIER" (carrier).',
    };
  }

  /**
   * Register a new user.
   * Requirement: Creating an account creates a new organization (warehouse or carrier)
   * and that user automatically becomes its Admin.
   * Also generates verificationToken and sends a verification email.
   */
  public async register(input: RegisterInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password], organizationName, organizationType, organizationId, role } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    if ([REDACTED:generic-password].length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    const normalizedEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();

    // Check if email already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    // Hash [REDACTED:generic-password] before transaction
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash([REDACTED:generic-password], securityConfig.saltRounds);

    // Generate secure email verification token
    const verificationToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

    // Scenario A: Standard Sign Up (Creates a new Organization & designates user as its Admin)
    if (!organizationId) {
      const orgType = this.normalizeOrganizationType(organizationType);

      // Automatically assign the user as Admin based on organization type
      const adminRole =
        orgType === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
          ? UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN
          : UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN;

      const orgName =
        organizationName?.trim() ||
        `${normalizedEmail.split('@')[0]} ${orgType === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR ? 'Warehouse' : 'Fleet'}`;

      // Execute atomically in a transaction
      const { user, organization } = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        const newOrg = await tx.organization.create({
          data: {
            name: orgName,
            type: orgType,
          },
        });

        const newUser = await tx.user.create({
          data: {
            email: normalizedEmail,
            [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
            role: adminRole,
            organizationId: newOrg.id,
            isActive: true,
            isEmailVerified: false,
            verificationToken,
          },
        });

        return { user: newUser, organization: newOrg };
      });

      // Send verification email asynchronously
      emailService.sendVerificationEmail(user.email, verificationToken).catch((err) => {
        console.error('[AuthService] Error dispatching verification email:', err);
      });

      const token = this.generateToken(user);

      return {
        token,
        user: {
          id: user.id,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
          organizationId: user.organizationId,
          isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
          organization: {
            id: organization.id,
            name: organization.name,
            type: organization.type,
          },
        },
      };
    }

    // Scenario B: Joining an existing Organization (e.g., invited employee/dispatcher)
    const existingOrg = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: organizationId },
    });

    if (!existingOrg) {
      throw { status: 404, message: `Organization with ID ${organizationId} not found.` };
    }

    const assignedRole =
      role ||
      (existingOrg.type === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
        ? UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER
        : UserRole.DISPATCHER);

    const user = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: normalizedEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
        role: assignedRole,
        organizationId: existingOrg.id,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: false,
        verificationToken,
      },
    });

    // Send verification email asynchronously
    emailService.sendVerificationEmail(user.email, verificationToken).catch((err) => {
      console.error('[AuthService] Error dispatching verification email:', err);
    });

    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
        organization: {
          id: existingOrg.id,
          name: existingOrg.name,
          type: existingOrg.type,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verify a user's email using the verification token.
   */
  public async verifyEmail(token: string): Promise<{ message: string; email: string }> {
    if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Verification token is required.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { verificationToken: token.trim() },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid or expired verification token.' };
    }

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: {
        isEmailVerified: true,
        verificationToken: null,
      },
    });

    return {
      message: 'Email verified successfully. Your account is now fully active.',
      email: user.email,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Resend a verification email.
   */
  public async resendVerification(input: ResendVerificationInput): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const { email, userId } = input;

    let user;
    if (userId) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    } else if (email) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() } });
    } else {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Either email or authenticated user ID is required.' };
    }

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    if (user.isEmailVerified) {
      return { message: 'Email is already verified.' };
    }

    // Generate a fresh token
    const verificationToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { verificationToken },
    });

    // Send verification email
    await emailService.sendVerificationEmail(user.email, verificationToken);

    return { message: 'A new verification email has been sent to your email address.' };
  }

  /**
   * Login an existing user and issue a JWT token.
   */
  public async login(input: LoginInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password] } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
      include: {
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    if (!user.isActive) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Account is deactivated. Please contact support.' };
    }

    const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare([REDACTED:generic-password], user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
    if (!isPasswordValid) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
        organization: user.organization,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Forgot [REDACTED:generic-password]: Sends a [REDACTED:generic-password] reset link to the user's email.
   * Mitigates user enumeration by always returning a generic success message.
   */
  public async forgotPassword(email: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const genericSuccess = {
      message: 'If an account with that email exists, a [REDACTED:generic-password] reset link has been sent.',
    };

    if (!email || typeof email !== 'string') {
      return genericSuccess;
    }

    const normalizedEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    });

    if (!user) {
      return genericSuccess;
    }

    // Generate secure random reset token and set expiration (1 hour from now)
    const resetPasswordToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const resetPasswordExpires = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000);

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: {
        resetPasswordToken,
        resetPasswordExpires,
      },
    });

    // Send reset email via Nodemailer
    emailService.sendPasswordResetEmail(user.email, resetPasswordToken).catch((err) => {
      console.error('[AuthService] Error dispatching [REDACTED:generic-password] reset email:', err);
    });

    return genericSuccess;
  }

  /**
   * Reset [REDACTED:generic-password] using a reset token.
   */
  public async resetPassword(token: string, newPassword: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Password reset token is required.' };
    }

    if (!newPassword || newPassword.length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'New [REDACTED:generic-password] must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findFirst({
      where: {
        resetPasswordToken: token.trim(),
        resetPasswordExpires: {
          gt: new Date(),
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid or expired [REDACTED:generic-password] reset token.' };
    }

    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, securityConfig.saltRounds);

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: {
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
        resetPasswordToken: null,
        resetPasswordExpires: null,
      },
    });

    return { message: 'Password has been reset successfully. You can now login with your new [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
  }

  /**
   * Change [REDACTED:generic-password] directly using email, old [REDACTED:generic-password], and new [REDACTED:generic-password].
   */
  public async changePassword(input: ChangePasswordInput): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const { email, oldPassword, newPassword } = input;

    if (!email || !oldPassword || !newPassword) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email, current [REDACTED:generic-password], and new [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'New [REDACTED:generic-password] must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(oldPassword, user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
    if (!isMatch) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Current [REDACTED:generic-password] does not match.' };
    }

    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, securityConfig.saltRounds);

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash },
    });

    return { message: 'Password changed successfully.' };
  }

  /**
   * Get user profile by ID.
   */
  public async getUserById(userId: number) {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: userId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        organizationId: true,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    return user;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { authService } from '../services/auth.service';

export const register = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const result = await authService.register(req.body);
    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'User registered successfully. A verification email has been sent.',
      data: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during registration.',
    });
  }
};

export const login = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const result = await authService.login(req.body);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Login successful.',
      data: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during login.',
    });
  }
};

export const verifyEmail = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const token = req.query.token as string;
    const result = await authService.verifyEmail(token);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
      data: { email: result.email },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Email verification failed.',
    });
  }
};

export const resendVerification = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const email = req.body.email;
    const userId = req.user?.userId;

    const result = await authService.resendVerification({ email, userId });
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Failed to resend verification email.',
    });
  }
};

export const forgotPassword = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { email } = req.body;
    const result = await authService.forgotPassword(email);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during [REDACTED:generic-password] reset request.',
    });
  }
};

export const resetPassword = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { token, newPassword } = req.body;
    const result = await authService.resetPassword(token, newPassword);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during [REDACTED:generic-password] reset.',
    });
  }
};

export const changePassword = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { email, oldPassword, newPassword } = req.body;
    const targetEmail = email || req.user?.email;

    const result = await authService.changePassword({
      email: targetEmail,
      oldPassword,
      newPassword,
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during [REDACTED:generic-password] change.',
    });
  }
};

export const getMe = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    if (!req.user?.userId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const user = await authService.getUserById(req.user.userId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        ...user,
        tenantContext: req.tenant,
      },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Failed to retrieve user profile.',
    });
  }
};
```

```typescript
import express from 'express';

import warehouseRoutes from './routes/warehouse.routes';

});

  app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`Server is running on port ${PORT}`);
  });
}

export default app;
```

```typescript
  register,

// Authenticated user endpoints

router.post('/change-[REDACTED:generic-password]', authenticate, changePassword);

export default router;
```

```typescript
    const regData = (await regRes.json()) as any;

    if (!regData.success || !regData.data?.token) {
      throw new Error('Registration failed!');
    }
    if (regData.data.user.role !== 'CARRIER_ADMIN') {
      throw new Error(`Expected CARRIER_ADMIN role but got: ${regData.data.user.role}`);
    }
    const registeredToken = regData.data.token;
    console.log('Verified user became Admin of new organization:', regData.data.user.organization);

    // 4. Test Change Password (POST /change-[REDACTED:generic-password]) using ONLY oldPassword and newPassword (no email)
    console.log('\n4. Testing Change Password with oldPassword and newPassword (no email)...');

  } finally {

  }
}

runTests().catch((err) => {
```

```typescript
import rateLimit from 'express-rate-limit';

/**
 * Strict rate limiter for authentication endpoints (login, forgot-[REDACTED:generic-password], reset-[REDACTED:generic-password]).
 * Limits each IP to 10 requests per 15-minute window to protect against automated dictionary attacks.

export const authRateLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  max: 10, // Limit each IP to 10 requests per window
  standardHeaders: true, // Return rate limit info in the `RateLimit-*` headers

  skipSuccessfulRequests: false,

  message: {
    success: false,
    message: 'Too many authentication attempts from this IP address. Please try again after 15 minutes.',
  },
});

export default authRateLimiter;
```

```diff
+  /**
+   * Login an existing user and issue a JWT token.
+   * Protects against brute-force attacks via temporary account lockout after 5 failed attempts.
+   */
+  public async login(input: LoginInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
+    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password] } = input;
+
+    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
+    }
+
+    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
+      where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
+      include: {
+        organization: {
+          select: {
+            id: true,
+            name: true,
+            type: true,
+          },
+        },
+      },
+    });
+
+    if (!user) {
+      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
+    }
+
+    if (!user.isActive) {
+      throw { status: 403, message: 'Account is deactivated. Please contact support.' };
+    }
+
+    // 1. Check if the account is currently locked
+    const now = new Date();
+    if (user.lockUntil && user.lockUntil > now) {
+      const remainingMinutes = Math.ceil((user.lockUntil.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (60 * 1000));
+      throw {
+        status: 423,
+        message: `Account is temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. Please try again in ${remainingMinutes} minute(s).`,
+      };
+    }
+
+    // 2. Validate [REDACTED:generic-password]
+    const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare([REDACTED:generic-password], user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
+
+    if (!isPasswordValid) {
+      const maxAttempts = 5;
+      const failedAttempts = (user.failedLoginAttempts || 0) + 1;
+
+      if (failedAttempts >= maxAttempts) {
+        // Lock account for 15 minutes
+        const lockUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000);
+        await prisma.user.update({
+          where: { id: user.id },
+          data: {
+            failedLoginAttempts: failedAttempts,
+            lockUntil,
+          },
+        });
+        throw {
+          status: 423,
+          message: 'Account is temporarily locked due to 5 consecutive failed login attempts. Please try again after 15 minutes.',
+        };
+      } else {
+        await prisma.user.update({
+          where: { id: user.id },
+          data: {
+            failedLoginAttempts: failedAttempts,
+          },
+        });
+        const remaining = maxAttempts - failedAttempts;
+        throw {
+          status: 401,
+          message: `Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password]. ${remaining} attempt(s) remaining before account lockout.`,
+        };
+      }
+    }
+
+    // 3. Password is valid: reset failed attempts and unlock account if needed
+    if (user.failedLoginAttempts > 0 || user.lockUntil !== null) {
+      await prisma.user.update({
+        where: { id: user.id },
+        data: {
+          failedLoginAttempts: 0,
+          lockUntil: null,
+        },
+      });
+    }
+
+    const token = this.generateToken(user);
+
+    return {
+      token,
+      user: {
+        id: user.id,
+        email: user.email,
+        role: user.role,
+        organizationId: user.organizationId,
+        isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
+        organization: user.organization,
+      },
+    };
+  }
```

```typescript
import http from 'http';
import app from '../index';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';

async function runLockoutAndRateLimitTests() {
  console.log('🧪 Starting Account Lockout & Rate Limiting Integration Tests...');

  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(5098, () => resolve()));
  const baseUrl = 'http://localhost:5098/api/auth';

  try {
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 1: Account Lockout after 5 Failed Password Attempts
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- TEST 1: Account Lockout Mechanism ---');
    const lockoutEmail = `lockout_test_${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]] = '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]';

    // Register a fresh test user
    console.log(`1. Registering user: ${lockoutEmail}`);
    const regRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/register`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: lockoutEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]],
        organizationName: 'Lockout Test Org',
        organizationType: 'CARRIER',
      }),
    });
    const regData = (await regRes.json()) as any;
    if (!regData.success) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to register test user: ${JSON.stringify(regData)}`);
    }

    // Attempt 1 to 4: Wrong [REDACTED:generic-password]s (should return 401)
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 4; attempt++) {
      console.log(`2.${attempt} Attempting login with wrong [REDACTED:generic-password] (Attempt ${attempt}/5)...`);
      const failRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/login`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: lockoutEmail,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
        }),
      });
      const failData = (await failRes.json()) as any;
      console.log(`   Status: ${failRes.status}, Message: "${failData.message}"`);

      if (failRes.status !== 401) {
        throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 401 on attempt ${attempt}, got ${failRes.status}`);
      }

      // Check failed attempts count in DB
      const userState = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: lockoutEmail } });
      if (userState?.failedLoginAttempts !== attempt) {
        throw new Error(`Expected failedLoginAttempts=${attempt}, got ${userState?.failedLoginAttempts}`);
      }
    }

    // Attempt 5: 5th wrong [REDACTED:generic-password] (should trigger account lockout and return 423)
    console.log('2.5 Attempting 5th wrong [REDACTED:generic-password] attempt (Threshold reached)...');
    const lockRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: lockoutEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
      }),
    });
    const lockData = (await lockRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`   Status: ${lockRes.status}, Message: "${lockData.message}"`);

    if (lockRes.status !== 423) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 423 on 5th failed attempt, got ${lockRes.status}`);
    }

    // Verify lockUntil is set in DB
    const lockedUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: lockoutEmail } });
    if (!lockedUser?.lockUntil || lockedUser.lockUntil <= new Date()) {
      throw new Error(`Expected user.lockUntil to be in the future, got: ${lockedUser?.lockUntil}`);
    }
    console.log(`   Verified DB lockUntil: ${lockedUser.lockUntil.toISOString()}`);

    // Attempt 6: Even with CORRECT [REDACTED:generic-password], login should be blocked with 423 while locked
    console.log('2.6 Attempting login with CORRECT [REDACTED:generic-password] while account is locked...');
    const blockedRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: lockoutEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]],
      }),
    });
    const blockedData = (await blockedRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`   Status: ${blockedRes.status}, Message: "${blockedData.message}"`);

    if (blockedRes.status !== 423) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 423 when logging in with correct [REDACTED:generic-password] while locked, got ${blockedRes.status}`);
    }

    // Simulate lockout expiry by clearing lockUntil in DB
    console.log('2.7 Simulating lock expiry in database...');
    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { email: lockoutEmail },
      data: { lockUntil: new Date(Date.now() - 1000) }, // Expired 1 second ago
    });

    // Attempt 7: Login with correct [REDACTED:generic-password] after lockout expired
    console.log('2.8 Attempting login with correct [REDACTED:generic-password] after lock expiry...');
    const unlockRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: lockoutEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]],
      }),
    });
    const unlockData = (await unlockRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`   Status: ${unlockRes.status}, Success: ${unlockData.success}`);

    if (unlockRes.status !== 200 || !unlockData.success) {
      throw new Error(`Login after lock expiry failed: ${JSON.stringify(unlockData)}`);
    }

    // Verify failedLoginAttempts is reset to 0 and lockUntil is cleared
    const unlockedUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: lockoutEmail } });
    if (unlockedUser?.failedLoginAttempts !== 0 || unlockedUser?.lockUntil !== null) {
      throw new Error(
        `Expected reset failedLoginAttempts=0 & lockUntil=null, got attempts=${unlockedUser?.failedLoginAttempts}, lockUntil=${unlockedUser?.lockUntil}`
      );
    }
    console.log('   Verified failedLoginAttempts was reset to 0 and lockUntil cleared.');

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 2: IP-Based Rate Limiting (Express Rate Limit)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- TEST 2: IP Rate Limiting ---');
    process.env.ENABLE_TEST_RATE_LIMIT = 'true';

    console.log('Sending requests up to rate limit threshold (10 max)...');
    let hitRateLimit = false;

    // Send requests to /login until limit exceeded (11 requests)
    for (let reqNum = 1; reqNum <= 12; reqNum++) {
      const rlRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/login`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: 'nonexistent@example.com',
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
        }),
      });

      if (rlRes.status === 429) {
        const rlData = (await rlRes.json()) as any;
        console.log(`   Request ${reqNum}: Rate limit hit! Status: 429, Message: "${rlData.message}"`);
        hitRateLimit = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!hitRateLimit) {
      throw new Error('Expected HTTP 429 Rate Limit exceeded, but limit was not hit!');
    }

    console.log('\n🎉 ALL LOCKOUT AND RATE LIMITING TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!');
  } finally {
    server.close();
    await prisma.$disconnect();
    process.exit(0);
  }
}

runLockoutAndRateLimitTests().catch((err) => {
  console.error('❌ Test failed:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

```

4. **Account Lockout Business Logic** ([`auth.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts)):
   - **Active Lockout Check**: If `user.lockUntil` is in the future, login is immediately rejected with HTTP `423 Locked` indicating the remaining lockout minutes.

     - On reaching $\ge 5$ attempts, sets `lockUntil` to 15 minutes in the future and returns HTTP `423 Locked`.
     - Prior to 5 attempts, returns HTTP `401 Unauthorized` notifying how many attempts remain before lockout.
   - **Successful Login Reset**:
     - Resets `failedLoginAttempts = 0` and clears `lockUntil = null`.

5. **Applied to Auth Routes** ([`auth.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/auth.routes.ts)):

```typescript
import { DockStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';

export interface CreateWarehouseInput {
  name: string;
  address: string;
  timezone: string;
}

export interface UpdateWarehouseInput {
  name?: string;
  address?: string;
  timezone?: string;
}

export interface CreateDockInput {
  name: string;
  status?: DockStatus;
}

/**
 * Validates whether a given string is a valid IANA time zone.
 * Uses Intl.DateTimeFormat which throws a RangeError for invalid time zone identifiers.
 */
export function isValidIanaTimeZone(timeZone: string): boolean {
  if (!timeZone || typeof timeZone !== 'string' || timeZone.trim() === '') {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZone: timeZone.trim() });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export class WarehouseService {
  /**
   * Creates a new warehouse for the specified organization.
   * Validates that the provided timezone is a valid IANA time zone string.
   */
  async createWarehouse(organizationId: number, data: CreateWarehouseInput) {
    if (!organizationId) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Organization ID is required.' };
    }

    if (!data.name || typeof data.name !== 'string' || !data.name.trim()) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Warehouse name is required.' };
    }

    if (!data.address || typeof data.address !== 'string' || !data.address.trim()) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Warehouse address is required.' };
    }

    if (!data.timezone || typeof data.timezone !== 'string' || !data.timezone.trim()) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Timezone is required.' };
    }

    const trimmedTimezone = data.timezone.trim();
    if (!isValidIanaTimeZone(trimmedTimezone)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: `Invalid IANA timezone string: '${trimmedTimezone}'.` };
    }

    // Verify organization exists
    const organization = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: organizationId },
    });

    if (!organization) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Organization not found.' };
    }

    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.create({
      data: {
        organizationId,
        name: data.name.trim(),
        address: data.address.trim(),
        timezone: trimmedTimezone,
      },
      include: {
        docks: true,
      },
    });

    return warehouse;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves all warehouses belonging to the specified organization.
   */
  async getWarehouses(organizationId: number) {
    if (!organizationId) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Organization ID is required.' };
    }

    const warehouses = await prisma.warehouse.findMany({
      where: { organizationId },
      include: {
        docks: true,
        operatingHours: true,
      },
      orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
    });

    return warehouses;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves a specific warehouse by ID, enforcing strict tenant isolation.
   */
  async getWarehouseById(warehouseId: number, organizationId: number) {
    if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
    }

    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
      where: { id: warehouseId },
      include: {
        docks: true,
        operatingHours: true,
      },
    });

    if (!warehouse) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
    }

    if (warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have access to this warehouse.' };
    }

    return warehouse;
  }

  /**
   * Updates an existing warehouse with tenant isolation check.
   */
  async updateWarehouse(warehouseId: number, organizationId: number, data: UpdateWarehouseInput) {
    if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
    }

    const existing = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
      where: { id: warehouseId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
    }

    if (existing.organizationId !== organizationId) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to update this warehouse.' };
    }

    if (data.timezone) {
      const trimmedTz = data.timezone.trim();
      if (!isValidIanaTimeZone(trimmedTz)) {
        throw { status: 400, message: `Invalid IANA timezone string: '${trimmedTz}'.` };
      }
    }

    const updated = await prisma.warehouse.update({
      where: { id: warehouseId },
      data: {
        ...(data.name && { name: data.name.trim() }),
        ...(data.address && { address: data.address.trim() }),
        ...(data.timezone && { timezone: data.timezone.trim() }),
      },
      include: {
        docks: true,
      },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Creates a dock for a warehouse, strictly verifying warehouse ownership.
   */
  async createDock(warehouseId: number, organizationId: number, data: CreateDockInput) {
    if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
    }

    if (!data.name || typeof data.name !== 'string' || !data.name.trim()) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Dock name is required.' };
    }

    if (data.status && !Object.values(DockStatus).includes(data.status)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: `Invalid dock status: '${data.status}'. Must be ACTIVE or MAINTENANCE.` };
    }

    // Verify warehouse exists and belongs to the caller's organization
    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
      where: { id: warehouseId },
    });

    if (!warehouse) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
    }

    if (warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage this warehouse.' };
    }

    const dock = await prisma.dock.create({
      data: {
        warehouseId,
        name: data.name.trim(),
        status: data.status || DockStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
    });

    return dock;
  }

  /**
   * Lists docks for a warehouse, enforcing strict tenant isolation.
   */
  async getDocks(warehouseId: number, organizationId: number) {
    if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
    }

    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
      where: { id: warehouseId },
    });

    if (!warehouse) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
    }

    if (warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have access to docks for this warehouse.' };
    }

    const docks = await prisma.dock.findMany({
      where: { warehouseId },
      orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
    });

    return docks;
  }

  /**
   * Updates dock status (e.g. toggling between ACTIVE and MAINTENANCE),
   * enforcing strict tenant isolation through the parent warehouse.
   */
  async updateDockStatus(dockId: number, organizationId: number, status: DockStatus) {
    if (!dockId || isNaN(dockId)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid dock ID.' };
    }

    if (!status || !Object.values(DockStatus).includes(status)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: `Invalid dock status: '${status}'. Must be ACTIVE or MAINTENANCE.` };
    }

    const dock = await prisma.dock.findUnique({
      where: { id: dockId },
      include: { warehouse: true },
    });

    if (!dock) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Dock not found.' };
    }

    if (dock.warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to modify this dock.' };
    }

    const updatedDock = await prisma.dock.update({
      where: { id: dockId },
      data: { status },
    });

    return updatedDock;
  }
}

export const warehouseService = new WarehouseService();
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { warehouseService } from '../services/warehouse.service';

/**
 * Creates a new warehouse for the authenticated user's organization.
 * POST /api/warehouses
 */
export const createWarehouse = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const { name, address, timezone } = req.body;
    const warehouse = await warehouseService.createWarehouse(organizationId, {
      name,
      address,
      timezone,
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Warehouse created successfully',
      data: warehouse,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while creating warehouse.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Retrieves all warehouses belonging to the authenticated user's organization.
 * GET /api/warehouses
 */
export const getWarehouses = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouses = await warehouseService.getWarehouses(organizationId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: warehouses,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while fetching warehouses.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Retrieves a single warehouse by ID for the authenticated user's organization.
 * GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId or /api/warehouses/:id
 */
export const getWarehouseById = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const rawId = req.params.warehouseId || req.params.id;
    const warehouseId = parseInt(rawId, 10);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouse = await warehouseService.getWarehouseById(warehouseId, organizationId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: warehouse,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while fetching warehouse.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Updates a warehouse for the authenticated user's organization.
 * PUT /api/warehouses/:warehouseId or /api/warehouses/:id
 */
export const updateWarehouse = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const rawId = req.params.warehouseId || req.params.id;
    const warehouseId = parseInt(rawId, 10);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const updated = await warehouseService.updateWarehouse(warehouseId, organizationId, req.body);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Warehouse updated successfully',
      data: updated,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while updating warehouse.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Creates a physical dock for a specific warehouse.
 * POST /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks
 */
export const createDock = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const rawId = req.params.warehouseId;
    const warehouseId = parseInt(rawId, 10);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const { name, status } = req.body;
    const dock = await warehouseService.createDock(warehouseId, organizationId, {
      name,
      status,
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Dock created successfully',
      data: dock,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while creating dock.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Retrieves all docks for a specific warehouse.
 * GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks
 */
export const getDocks = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;

    const rawId = req.params.warehouseId;
    const warehouseId = parseInt(rawId, 10);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({

  } catch (error: any) {

    res.status(status).json({

    });
  }

      });

    const rawId = req.params.dockId;

    });
  }
};
```

```typescript
import { Router } from 'express';
import {
  getWarehouses,
  getWarehouseById,
  createWarehouse,
  updateWarehouse,
  createDock,
  getDocks,
  updateDockStatus,
} from '../controllers/warehouse.controller';
import { authMiddleware } from '../middleware/auth.middleware';
import { requireVerifiedEmail } from '../middleware/verification.middleware';
import { authorize } from '../middleware/rbac.middleware';

const router = Router();

// 1. Warehouse collection routes
router.get('/', authMiddleware, authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER']), getWarehouses);
router.post('/', authMiddleware, requireVerifiedEmail, authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN']), createWarehouse);

// 2. Direct dock status route (placed before /:warehouseId to avoid param collision)
router.patch(
  '/docks/:dockId/status',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER']),
  updateDockStatus
);

// 3. Single warehouse routes
router.get('/:warehouseId', authMiddleware, authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER']), getWarehouseById);
router.put('/:warehouseId', authMiddleware, requireVerifiedEmail, authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN']), updateWarehouse);

// 4. Warehouse dock routes
router.post(
  '/:warehouseId/docks',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER']),
  createDock
);
router.get('/:warehouseId/docks', authMiddleware, authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER']), getDocks);
router.patch(
  '/:warehouseId/docks/:dockId/status',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER']),
  updateDockStatus
);

export default router;

```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { warehouseService } from '../services/warehouse.service';

/**
 * Safely parses numeric route parameters.
 */
function parseParamId(val: string | string[] | undefined): number {
  if (!val) return NaN;
  const str = Array.isArray(val) ? val[0] : val;
  return parseInt(str, 10);
}

/**
 * Creates a new warehouse for the authenticated user's organization.
 * POST /api/warehouses
 */
export const createWarehouse = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const { name, address, timezone } = req.body;
    const warehouse = await warehouseService.createWarehouse(organizationId, {
      name,
      address,
      timezone,
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Warehouse created successfully',
      data: warehouse,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while creating warehouse.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Retrieves all warehouses belonging to the authenticated user's organization.
 * GET /api/warehouses
 */
export const getWarehouses = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouses = await warehouseService.getWarehouses(organizationId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: warehouses,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while fetching warehouses.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Retrieves a single warehouse by ID for the authenticated user's organization.
 * GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId or /api/warehouses/:id
 */
export const getWarehouseById = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouseId = parseParamId(req.params.warehouseId || req.params.id);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouse = await warehouseService.getWarehouseById(warehouseId, organizationId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: warehouse,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while fetching warehouse.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Updates a warehouse for the authenticated user's organization.
 * PUT /api/warehouses/:warehouseId or /api/warehouses/:id
 */
export const updateWarehouse = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouseId = parseParamId(req.params.warehouseId || req.params.id);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const updated = await warehouseService.updateWarehouse(warehouseId, organizationId, req.body);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Warehouse updated successfully',
      data: updated,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while updating warehouse.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Creates a physical dock for a specific warehouse.
 * POST /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks
 */
export const createDock = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouseId = parseParamId(req.params.warehouseId);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const { name, status } = req.body;
    const dock = await warehouseService.createDock(warehouseId, organizationId, {
      name,
      status,
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Dock created successfully',
      data: dock,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while creating dock.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Retrieves all docks for a specific warehouse.
 * GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks
 */
export const getDocks = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const warehouseId = parseParamId(req.params.warehouseId);
    if (isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const docks = await warehouseService.getDocks(warehouseId, organizationId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: docks,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while fetching docks.',
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Updates dock status (ACTIVE / MAINTENANCE).
 * PATCH /api/warehouses/docks/:dockId/status
 * (also supports PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks/:dockId/status)
 */
export const updateDockStatus = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
    if (!organizationId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const dockId = parseParamId(req.params.dockId);
    if (isNaN(dockId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid dock ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const { status } = req.body;
    const updatedDock = await warehouseService.updateDockStatus(dockId, organizationId, status);

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Dock status updated successfully',
      data: updatedDock,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while updating dock status.',
    });
  }
};
```

```typescript
import http from 'http';
import app from '../index';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';

async function runWarehouseAndDockTests() {
  console.log('🧪 Starting Warehouse & Dock Management Integration Tests...');

  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(5097, () => resolve()));
  const baseUrl = 'http://localhost:5097/api';

  try {
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // SETUP: Log in as Warehouse Admin (Apex), GMT Admin, and Carrier
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- SETUP: Logging in test users ---');

    // Apex Warehouse Admin
    const apexLoginRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'warehouse_admin@apex.com', [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]' }),
    });
    const apexLogin = (await apexLoginRes.json()) as any;
    const apexToken = apexLogin.data.token;
    const apexOrgId = apexLogin.data.user.organizationId;
    console.log(`Apex Admin logged in. OrgId: ${apexOrgId}`);

    // GMT Warehouse Admin (Cross-tenant user)
    const gmtLoginRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'admin@gmtlogistics.com', [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]' }),
    });
    const gmtLogin = (await gmtLoginRes.json()) as any;
    const gmtToken = gmtLogin.data.token;
    const gmtOrgId = gmtLogin.data.user.organizationId;
    console.log(`GMT Admin logged in. OrgId: ${gmtOrgId}`);

    // Carrier Admin (Unauthorized role for warehouse management)
    const carrierLoginRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'carrier_admin@swiftfreight.com', [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]' }),
    });
    const carrierLogin = (await carrierLoginRes.json()) as any;

    if (carrierCreateRes.status !== 403) {

    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------

    // 2.1 Missing fields

    const missingRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Incomplete Warehouse' }),

    const missingData = (await missingRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`Missing fields status: ${missingRes.status}, message: "${missingData.message}"`);
    if (missingRes.status !== 400) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 400 for missing fields, got ${missingRes.status}`);
    }

    // 2.2 Invalid IANA timezone

        Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}`,

      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: 'Bad Timezone Warehouse',
        address: '456 Dock Way',
        timezone: 'Mars/Curiosity_Rover',
      }),
    });
    const invalidTzData = (await invalidTzRes.json()) as any;

    if (invalidTzRes.status !== 400) {

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 3: List Warehouses for Organization (GET /api/warehouses)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- TEST 3: List Organization Warehouses ---');
    const listRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}` },
    });
    const listData = (await listRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`List status: ${listRes.status}, Total warehouses found: ${listData.data?.length}`);
    if (listRes.status !== 200 || !Array.isArray(listData.data)) {
      throw new Error('Failed to list organization warehouses.');
    }
    const foundCreated = listData.data.some((w: any) => w.id === createdWarehouse.id);
    if (!foundCreated) {
      throw new Error('Created warehouse not found in organization list.');
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 4: Single Warehouse & Tenant Isolation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- TEST 4: Get Warehouse & Cross-Tenant Isolation ---');
    // 4.1 Apex admin gets their own warehouse
    const getOwnRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/${createdWarehouse.id}`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}` },
    });
    if (getOwnRes.status !== 200) {
      throw new Error(`Apex admin failed to fetch own warehouse: ${getOwnRes.status}`);
    }

    // 4.2 GMT admin attempts to get Apex's warehouse (Cross-tenant)
    const getCrossRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/${createdWarehouse.id}`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${gmtToken}` },
    });
    const getCrossData = (await getCrossRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`Cross-tenant get warehouse status: ${getCrossRes.status}, message: "${getCrossData.message}"`);
    if (getCrossRes.status !== 403) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 403 for cross-tenant warehouse access, got ${getCrossRes.status}`);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 5: Dock Creation (POST /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- TEST 5: Dock Creation & Tenant Isolation ---');

    // 5.1 Cross-tenant dock creation: GMT admin attempts to add dock to Apex warehouse
    console.log('5.1 Cross-tenant dock creation attempt...');
    const crossDockRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/${createdWarehouse.id}/docks`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${gmtToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'GMT Illegal Dock' }),
    });
    const crossDockData = (await crossDockRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`Cross-tenant dock creation status: ${crossDockRes.status}, message: "${crossDockData.message}"`);
    if (crossDockRes.status !== 403) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 403 for cross-tenant dock creation, got ${crossDockRes.status}`);
    }

    // 5.2 Invalid dock payload (missing name)
    console.log('5.2 Testing missing dock name validation...');
    const badDockRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/${createdWarehouse.id}/docks`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({}),
    });
    if (badDockRes.status !== 400) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 400 for missing dock name, got ${badDockRes.status}`);
    }

    // 5.3 Valid dock creation
    console.log('5.3 Creating physical dock for Apex warehouse...');
    const createDockRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/${createdWarehouse.id}/docks`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: 'Dock Bay 101 (Refrigerated)',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      }),
    });
    const createDockData = (await createDockRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`Dock creation status: ${createDockRes.status}, Dock ID: ${createDockData.data?.id}`);
    if (createDockRes.status !== 201 || !createDockData.data?.id) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to create dock: ${JSON.stringify(createDockData)}`);
    }
    const createdDock = createDockData.data;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 6: List Docks (GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- TEST 6: List Docks & Cross-Tenant Guard ---');

    // 6.1 Apex admin fetches docks
    const listDocksRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/${createdWarehouse.id}/docks`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}` },
    });
    const listDocksData = (await listDocksRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`List docks status: ${listDocksRes.status}, Docks count: ${listDocksData.data?.length}`);
    if (listDocksRes.status !== 200 || !listDocksData.data?.some((d: any) => d.id === createdDock.id)) {
      throw new Error('Created dock not present in docks list.');
    }

    // 6.2 GMT admin tries to list Apex warehouse docks
    const crossListDocksRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/${createdWarehouse.id}/docks`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${gmtToken}` },
    });
    console.log(`Cross-tenant list docks status: ${crossListDocksRes.status}`);
    if (crossListDocksRes.status !== 403) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 403 for cross-tenant dock list, got ${crossListDocksRes.status}`);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 7: Update Dock Status (PATCH /api/warehouses/docks/:dockId/status)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n--- TEST 7: Update Dock Status (Maintenance Toggle) ---');

    // 7.1 Cross-tenant update: GMT admin tries to change Apex dock status
    console.log('7.1 Cross-tenant dock status update attempt...');
    const crossUpdateRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/docks/${createdDock.id}/status`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${gmtToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'MAINTENANCE' }),
    });
    const crossUpdateData = (await crossUpdateRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`Cross-tenant dock status update: ${crossUpdateRes.status}, message: "${crossUpdateData.message}"`);
    if (crossUpdateRes.status !== 403) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 403 for cross-tenant dock update, got ${crossUpdateRes.status}`);
    }

    // 7.2 Invalid status value
    console.log('7.2 Testing invalid dock status value...');
    const badStatusRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/docks/${createdDock.id}/status`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'DESTROYED' }),
    });
    if (badStatusRes.status !== 400) {
      throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 400 for invalid status, got ${badStatusRes.status}`);
    }

    // 7.3 Valid status update: Toggle to MAINTENANCE
    console.log('7.3 Updating dock status to MAINTENANCE...');
    const toMaintenanceRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/docks/${createdDock.id}/status`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'MAINTENANCE' }),
    });
    const toMaintenanceData = (await toMaintenanceRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`Status update result: ${toMaintenanceRes.status}, Dock status: ${toMaintenanceData.data?.status}`);
    if (toMaintenanceRes.status !== 200 || toMaintenanceData.data?.status !== 'MAINTENANCE') {
      throw new Error(`Failed to update dock status to MAINTENANCE: ${JSON.stringify(toMaintenanceData)}`);
    }

    // Verify database record
    const dbDock = await prisma.dock.findUnique({ where: { id: createdDock.id } });
    if (dbDock?.status !== 'MAINTENANCE') {
      throw new Error(`Database dock status expected to be MAINTENANCE, got: ${dbDock?.status}`);
    }
    console.log('Verified database reflects dock status = MAINTENANCE.');

    // 7.4 Toggle back to ACTIVE
    console.log('7.4 Updating dock status back to ACTIVE...');
    const toActiveRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses/docks/${createdDock.id}/status`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apexToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'ACTIVE' }),
    });
    const toActiveData = (await toActiveRes.json()) as any;
    console.log(`Status update result: ${toActiveRes.status}, Dock status: ${toActiveData.data?.status}`);
    if (toActiveRes.status !== 200 || toActiveData.data?.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
      throw new Error(`Failed to update dock status back to ACTIVE: ${JSON.stringify(toActiveData)}`);
    }

    console.log('\n🎉 ALL WAREHOUSE AND DOCK MANAGEMENT TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!');
  } finally {
    server.close();
    await prisma.$disconnect();
    process.exit(0);
  }
}

runWarehouseAndDockTests().catch((err) => {
```

### Implementation Details

#### 1. Warehouse Service ([`backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts))
- **IANA Time Zone Validation**: Implemented `isValidIanaTimeZone` using `Intl.DateTimeFormat` (which validates against canonical and IANA time zones such as `Asia/Colombo`, `America/New_York`, `UTC`, and throws for invalid time zones like `Mars/Curiosity_Rover`).
- **Warehouse Management**:
  - `createWarehouse`: Validates required fields (`name`, `address`, `timezone`), validates IANA timezone string, and creates the warehouse record linked to the organization.
  - `getWarehouses`: Retrieves all warehouses belonging to the user's organization with docks and operating hours.
  - `getWarehouseById`: Retrieves a single warehouse, enforcing strict tenant isolation (returns 403 if accessed across organizations).
  - `updateWarehouse`: Updates warehouse details while maintaining tenant boundary checks.
- **Dock Management**:
  - `createDock`: Checks that the parent warehouse exists and belongs to the caller's organization (throws 404 if not found, 403 if belonging to a different tenant). Creates a physical dock with status `ACTIVE` or `MAINTENANCE`.
  - `getDocks`: Lists all docks for a warehouse, strictly verifying organization ownership.
  - `updateDockStatus`: Toggles dock status (`ACTIVE` $\leftrightarrow$ `MAINTENANCE`) and enforces tenant isolation via the dock's parent warehouse.

#### 2. Warehouse Controller ([`backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts))
- Handles all endpoint operations with type-safe route parameter parsing (`parseParamId`) and consistent error handling:
  - `POST /api/warehouses`: Creates a new warehouse.
  - `GET /api/warehouses`: Lists the calling organization's warehouses.
  - `GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId`: Fetches a single warehouse.
  - `POST /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks`: Creates a dock for a warehouse.
  - `GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks`: Lists all docks for a warehouse.
  - `PATCH /api/warehouses/docks/:dockId/status`: Updates dock maintenance status.

#### 3. Middleware & RBAC Enforcement
- **Auth Middleware** ([`backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts)): Exported `authMiddleware` alias to secure routes with JWT validation.
- **RBAC Middleware** ([`backend/src/middleware/rbac.middleware.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/rbac.middleware.ts)): Implemented `authorize(allowedRoles)` to reject unauthorized roles (such as `CARRIER_ADMIN` or `DISPATCHER`) with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
- **Email Verification Guard** ([`backend/src/middleware/verification.middleware.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/verification.middleware.ts)): Ensures unverified accounts cannot mutate warehouses or docks.

```text
1: # PLAN.md: DockSlot Project Plan
2: 
3: ## 1. Understanding of the Problem
4: DockSlot is a multi-tenant B2B platform connecting two distinct organization types with strict data isolation:
5: - **Warehouse Operators:** Manage warehouses, physical docks, operating hours, slot durations, and view/manage truck arrivals.
6: - **Carriers (Dispatchers & Admins):** Search available dock slots across warehouses in local time, book slots for trucks, and manage their organization's bookings.
7: 
8: The core technical challenges involve:
9: - **Strict Concurrency Control:** Preventing double-booking under high contention when multiple dispatchers attempt to book the exact same slot simultaneously.
10: - **Time Zone Handling:** Generating accurate slot schedules based on each warehouse's local time zone (e.g., Asia/Colombo, Europe/Amsterdam) regardless of server or user browser time zones.
11: - **Asynchronous Resilience:** Communicating booking events to an unstable third-party webhook (Carrier Notify API) with random delays, failures, and hangs without degrading user-facing booking performance.
12: 
13: ---
14: 
15: ## 2. Questions for the Product Owner
16: 1. **Anti-Hogging Rules (W5):** What is the exact mathematical threshold or rule for "hogging" warehouse slots (e.g., maximum active bookings per carrier per day/week)? *Assumption for now: Implement a configurable soft/hard limit per carrier per day per warehouse.*
17: 2. **Notification Retries (N3):** For guaranteed eventual delivery without duplicates, should we implement an outbox pattern with an internal background worker job, or a simple database-backed retry queue? *Assumption: Use a lightweight transactional outbox table with periodic background polling/retry.*
18: 3. **Rescheduling Conflicts (B5):** When rescheduling a booking, does it release the old slot atomically within the same transaction as booking the new slot? *Assumption: Yes, wrapped in a serializable or repeatable-read database transaction.*
19: 
20: ---
21: 
22: ## 3. Top Risks
23: 1. **Race Conditions in Slot Booking:** Two dispatchers clicking "Book" at the exact same millisecond could result in a double-booking if database isolation levels or locking mechanisms are insufficient.
24:    - *Mitigation:* Use database-level unique constraints on `(dock_id, slot_start_time)` combined with explicit row-level locking (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`) or optimistic concurrency control.
25: 2. **Unreliable Third-Party Notify API:** The fake notify service has 20% failures, 5% 30-second hangs, and random 1–5s latency. Synchronous calls would break user experience.
26:    - *Mitigation:* Decouple notifications using an asynchronous queue/outbox worker so web responses return instantly (`N2`).
27: 3. **Time Zone Offset Discrepancies:** Storing slot timestamps incorrectly in UTC vs. local time can lead to off-by-one-hour errors during daylight saving transitions or multi-region queries.
28:    - *Mitigation:* Store all timestamps as UTC in the database, but compute and query slot boundaries strictly relative to the warehouse's IANA time zone.
29: 
30: ---
31: 
32: ## 4. Architecture Sketch
33: 
34: <img width="1476" height="927" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1ab073c8-3e99-47c4-a26e-1d1bd8efc838" />

38: 
39: - **Phase 1: Foundation & Auth (PO)**
40:   - Set up Docker Compose (`app`, database, Mailpit/mail catcher, fake notify service).
41:   - Implement database schema (Organizations, Users, Warehouses, Docks, Bookings, Audit/Outbox logs).
42:   - Build email/[REDACTED:generic-password] auth, role-based access control (RBAC), and email verification.
43: - **Phase 2: Core Warehouse & Slot Engine (PO)**
44:   - Warehouse & dock management for Warehouse Admins.
45:   - Slot generator algorithm handling warehouse local time zones, operating hours, and slot lengths.
46:   - Slot search API and frontend view (`B1`, `U1`, `U2`).
47: - **Phase 3: Bookings & Concurrency Control (PO)**
48:   - Booking creation endpoint with strict double-booking prevention (`B3`).
49:   - Automated concurrency test script firing concurrent requests to prove zero double-bookings.
50:   - Cancellation flow and inventory release.
51: - **Phase 4: Notifications & Asynchronous Reliability (PO/P1)**
52:   - Build the fake Carrier Notify API service matching spec (`5.1`).
53:   - Implement asynchronous webhook dispatch / outbox pattern to ensure user actions stay fast (`N2`).
54: - **Phase 5: UI Refinements & P1 Features**
```
