```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole, DockStatus, BookingStatus } from '@prisma/client';

describe('Dock Maintenance Closures & Booking Status Management Tests', () => {
  let warehouseOrgAId: number;
  let warehouseAdminAToken: string;
  let dockManagerAToken: string;
  let dockManagerAId: number;

  let warehouseOrgBId: number;
  let dockManagerBToken: string;

  let testWarehouseId: number;
  let dock1Id: number;
  let dock2Id: number;

  let carrierOrgId: number;
  let dispatcherToken: string;

  // Time slots in UTC (Asia/Colombo UTC+5:30)
  const slotDate = '2026-11-15';
  const slot1Start = '2026-11-15T04:00:00.000Z';
  const slot1End = '2026-11-15T04:30:00.000Z';

  const slot2Start = '2026-11-15T05:00:00.000Z';
  const slot2End = '2026-11-15T05:30:00.000Z';

  const closureStart = '2026-11-15T04:45:00.000Z';
  const closureEnd = '2026-11-15T05:45:00.000Z';

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Create Warehouse Operator Org A & Warehouse with 2 docks
    const warehouseOrgA = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Warehouse Org A Maintenance ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgAId = warehouseOrgA.id;

    const warehouseAdminA = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        email: `wh_admin_${Date.now()}@wh-a.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminAToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: warehouseAdminA.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        role: warehouseAdminA.role,
        email: warehouseAdminA.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    const dockManagerA = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        email: `dock_mgr_${Date.now()}@wh-a.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dockManagerAId = dockManagerA.id;
    dockManagerAToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dockManagerA.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        role: dockManagerA.role,
        email: dockManagerA.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 2. Create Warehouse Operator Org B & Dock Manager B (for tenant isolation)
    const warehouseOrgB = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Warehouse Org B Maintenance ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgBId = warehouseOrgB.id;

    const dockManagerB = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgBId,
        email: `dock_mgr_b_${Date.now()}@wh-b.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dockManagerBToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dockManagerB.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgBId,
        role: dockManagerB.role,
        email: dockManagerB.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 3. Create Warehouse
    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        name: 'Maintenance Testing DC',
        address: '12 Harbor Line, Colombo',
        timezone: 'Asia/Colombo',
        operatingHours: {
          create: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayOfWeek) => ({
            dayOfWeek,
            openTime: '00:00',
            closeTime: '24:00',
            slotLengthMinutes: 30,
          })),
        },
        docks: {
          create: [
            { name: 'Dock 1 - Maintenance Target', status: DockStatus.ACTIVE },
            { name: 'Dock 2 - Control Dock', status: DockStatus.ACTIVE },
          ],
        },
      },
      include: { docks: true },
    });
    testWarehouseId = warehouse.id;
    dock1Id = warehouse.docks[0].id;
    dock2Id = warehouse.docks[1].id;

    // 4. Create Carrier Org & Dispatcher
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Carrier Org Maintenance ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const dispatcher = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `dispatcher_m_${Date.now()}@carrier.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dispatcher.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: dispatcher.role,
        email: dispatcher.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await prisma.dockClosure.deleteMany({
        where: { dockId: { in: [dock1Id, dock2Id] } },
      });
      await prisma.auditLog.deleteMany({
        where: { booking: { dockId: { in: [dock1Id, dock2Id] } } },
      });
      await prisma.outboxEvent.deleteMany({
        where: {
          aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
          payload: { path: ['warehouseId'], equals: testWarehouseId },
        },
      });
      await prisma.booking.deleteMany({ where: { dockId: { in: [dock1Id, dock2Id] } } });
      await prisma.dock.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: [dock1Id, dock2Id] } } });
      await prisma.operatingHour.deleteMany({ where: { warehouseId: testWarehouseId } });
      await prisma.warehouse.deleteMany({ where: { id: testWarehouseId } });
      await prisma.user.deleteMany({
        where: { organizationId: { in: [warehouseOrgAId, warehouseOrgBId, carrierOrgId] } },
      });
      await prisma.organization.deleteMany({
        where: { id: { in: [warehouseOrgAId, warehouseOrgBId, carrierOrgId] } },
      });
    } catch {
      // Ignore cleanup error
    } finally {
      await prisma.$disconnect();
    }
  });

  let testBookingId: number;

  it('allows carrier dispatcher to create a booking', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/bookings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
      .send({
        dockId: dock1Id,
        slotStartTime: slot1Start,
        slotEndTime: slot1End,
        truckPlate: 'TRK-MNT-01',
        driverName: 'Sarath Fonseka',
        driverPhone: '+94770011223',
        cargoNote: 'Initial load for maintenance tests',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.id).toBeDefined();
    testBookingId = res.body.data.id;
  });

  it('rejects dock closure scheduling if it overlaps with an active booking (409 Conflict)', async () => {
    // Attempt to schedule closure overlapping slot 1 (04:00 - 04:30)
    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/docks/${dock1Id}/closures`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerAToken}`)
      .send({
        startTime: '2026-11-15T04:15:00.000Z',
        endTime: '2026-11-15T04:45:00.000Z',
        reason: 'Emergency crane inspection',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(409);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.message).toContain('active booking exists');
  });

  it('rejects dock closure creation from unauthorized organization (strict tenant isolation)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/docks/${dock1Id}/closures`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerBToken}`)
      .send({
        startTime: closureStart,
        endTime: closureEnd,
        reason: 'Unauthorized closure attempt by warehouse B',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.message).toContain('Forbidden');
  });

  it('successfully creates a scheduled dock maintenance closure (201 Created)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/docks/${dock1Id}/closures`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
      .send({
        startTime: closureStart,
        endTime: closureEnd,
        reason: 'Scheduled hydraulic lift maintenance',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.id).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.data.reason).toBe('Scheduled hydraulic lift maintenance');

    // Verify GET /api/docks/:dockId/closures
    const getRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/docks/${dock1Id}/closures`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerAToken}`);

    expect(getRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(getRes.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(getRes.body.data.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it('slot generation engine automatically filters out time slots under maintenance closure', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/slots?date=${slotDate}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);

    const dock1Mapping = res.body.data.find((d: any) => d.dockId === dock1Id);
    expect(dock1Mapping).toBeDefined();

    // slot2Start (05:00 - 05:30) falls strictly inside closure (04:45 - 05:45) -> MUST BE BLOCKED
    const slot2InDock1 = dock1Mapping.slots.find(
      (s: any) => s.slotStartTime === slot2Start
    );
    expect(slot2InDock1).toBeUndefined();

    // Dock 2 (Control dock) does NOT have closure -> slot2Start MUST be available on Dock 2
    const dock2Mapping = res.body.data.find((d: any) => d.dockId === dock2Id);
    expect(dock2Mapping).toBeDefined();
    const slot2InDock2 = dock2Mapping.slots.find(
      (s: any) => s.slotStartTime === slot2Start
    );
    expect(slot2InDock2).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('rejects direct booking creation attempt on a slot during scheduled maintenance', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/bookings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
      .send({
        dockId: dock1Id,
        slotStartTime: slot2Start,
        slotEndTime: slot2End,
        truckPlate: 'TRK-MNT-99',
        driverName: 'Test Driver',
        driverPhone: '+94770000000',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.message).toContain('scheduled dock maintenance');
  });

  it('rejects status change by non-dock-manager roles (strict RBAC)', async () => {
    // Carrier Dispatcher attempts to mark booking as ARRIVED
    const resCarrier = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/bookings/${testBookingId}/status`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
      .send({ status: 'ARRIVED' });

    expect(resCarrier.status).toBe(403);
    expect(resCarrier.body.message).toContain('Forbidden');

    // Warehouse Admin attempts to mark booking as ARRIVED (strictly DOCK_MANAGER required)
    const resAdmin = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/bookings/${testBookingId}/status`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
      .send({ status: 'ARRIVED' });

    expect(resAdmin.status).toBe(403);
    expect(resAdmin.body.message).toContain('Only Dock Managers are permitted');
  });

  it('rejects status change from dock manager of an unrelated warehouse organization (tenant isolation)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/bookings/${testBookingId}/status`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerBToken}`)
      .send({ status: 'ARRIVED' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.message).toContain('Forbidden');
  });

  it('allows Dock Manager to update status to ARRIVED and generates STATUS_CHANGED audit log', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/bookings/${testBookingId}/status`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerAToken}`)
      .send({ status: 'ARRIVED' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('ARRIVED');

    // Verify Audit Log
    const auditLogs = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
      where: { bookingId: testBookingId, action: 'STATUS_CHANGED' },
    });
    expect(auditLogs.length).toBe(1);
    expect(auditLogs[0].action).toBe('STATUS_CHANGED');
    expect(auditLogs[0].userId).toBe(dockManagerAId);
    expect((auditLogs[0].details as any).oldStatus).toBe('BOOKED');
    expect((auditLogs[0].details as any).newStatus).toBe('ARRIVED');
  });

  it('allows Dock Manager to advance status to COMPLETED and records audit log', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/bookings/${testBookingId}/status`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerAToken}`)
      .send({ status: 'COMPLETED' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('COMPLETED');

    const auditLogs = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
      where: { bookingId: testBookingId, action: 'STATUS_CHANGED' },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
    });
    expect(auditLogs.length).toBe(2);
    expect((auditLogs[1].details as any).oldStatus).toBe('ARRIVED');
    expect((auditLogs[1].details as any).newStatus).toBe('COMPLETED');
  });
});
```

### Summary of Changes

### Implementation Details

1. **Prisma Schema Updates** ([`schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma)):
   - **`DockClosure` Model**:
     ```prisma
     model DockClosure {
       id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
       dockId    Int
       startTime DateTime
       endTime   DateTime
       reason    String?
       createdAt DateTime @default(now())

       dock      Dock     @relation(fields: [dockId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

       @@index([dockId])
       @@map("dock_closures")
     }
     ```
   - **`BookingStatus` Enum**: Updated to include `BOOKED`, `ARRIVED`, `NO_SHOW`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`.
   - Database synchronized via `npx prisma db push` and Prisma Client regenerated.

2. **Dock Maintenance Service & Slot Generation Engine** ([`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts)):
   - **`createDockClosure`**:
     - Validates tenant ownership (`dock.warehouse.organizationId === warehouseAdminOrgId`).
     - Validates time window (`startTime < endTime`).
     - Detects conflicts with active bookings (`status in [BOOKED, ARRIVED]`) and throws a 409 Conflict error.
     - Persists the closure record.
   - **`getDockClosures`**: Retrieves all maintenance closure ranges for a dock with tenant isolation checks.
   - **Slot Generation Engine Update (`getAvailableSlots`)**:
     - Queries scheduled `DockClosure` records for the target docks overlapping the requested date bounds.
     - Automatically filters out and blocks any time slot that overlaps with a maintenance closure window.
   - **Direct Booking Guard**: Updated `createBooking` and `rescheduleBooking` in [`booking.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/booking.service.ts) to reject booking attempts on slots under scheduled dock maintenance.

   - **Dock Maintenance Routes** ([`dock.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/dock.routes.ts) & [`warehouse.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts)):

```diff
+  async updateWarehouseSettings(
+    warehouseId: number,
+    organizationId: number,
+    data: UpdateWarehouseSettingsInput
+  ) {
+    if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
+    }
+
+    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
+      where: { id: warehouseId },
+      include: {
+        operatingHours: true,
+        docks: true,
+      },
+    });
+
+    if (!warehouse) {
+      throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
+    }
+
+    if (warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
+      throw {
+        status: 403,
+        message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage settings for this warehouse.',
+      };
+    }
+
+    if (data.slotLengthMinutes !== undefined) {
+      const slotLength = data.slotLengthMinutes;
+      const allowedIncrements = [15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120];
+
+      if (
+        typeof slotLength !== 'number' ||
+        !Number.isInteger(slotLength) ||
+        slotLength <= 0 ||
+        (!allowedIncrements.includes(slotLength) && 1440 % slotLength !== 0)
+      ) {
+        throw {
+          status: 400,
+          message: `Invalid slotLengthMinutes: ${slotLength}. Allowed increments must divide evenly into operating schedules (e.g., 30, 45, 60 minutes).`,
+        };

+

+      }

+          ...(data.address && { address: data.address.trim() }),

+          ...(data.slotLengthMinutes !== undefined && { slotLengthMinutes: data.slotLengthMinutes }),

+        include: {
+          docks: true,
+          operatingHours: true,
+        },
+      });
+
+      if (data.slotLengthMinutes !== undefined) {

+

+
```

```diff
   /**
+   * Updates warehouse settings (e.g., default slotLengthMinutes) with strict tenant isolation.
+   * Validates that slotLengthMinutes is a valid increment (e.g., 30, 45, 60 minutes) that divides evenly
+   * into operating schedules, and updates both the warehouse and its operating hours records.
+   * Existing confirmed bookings retain their original time ranges and remain unaffected.
+   */
+  async updateWarehouseSettings(
+    warehouseId: number,
+    organizationId: number,
+    data: UpdateWarehouseSettingsInput
+  ) {
+    if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
+    }
+
+    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
+      where: { id: warehouseId },
+      include: {
+        operatingHours: true,
+        docks: true,
+      },
+    });
+
+    if (!warehouse) {
+      throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
+    }
+
+    if (warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
+      throw {
+        status: 403,
+        message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage settings for this warehouse.',
+      };
+    }
+
+    if (data.slotLengthMinutes !== undefined) {
+      const slotLength = data.slotLengthMinutes;
+      const allowedIncrements = [15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120];
+
+      if (
+        typeof slotLength !== 'number' ||
+        !Number.isInteger(slotLength) ||
+        slotLength <= 0 ||
+        (!allowedIncrements.includes(slotLength) && 1440 % slotLength !== 0)
+      ) {
+        throw {
+          status: 400,
+          message: `Invalid slotLengthMinutes: ${slotLength}. Allowed increments must divide evenly into operating schedules (e.g., 30, 45, 60 minutes).`,
+        };
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (data.timezone) {
+      const trimmedTz = data.timezone.trim();
+      if (!isValidIanaTimeZone(trimmedTz)) {
+        throw { status: 400, message: `Invalid IANA timezone string: '${trimmedTz}'.` };
+      }
+    }
+
+    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const updated = await tx.warehouse.update({
+        where: { id: warehouseId },
+        data: {
+          ...(data.name && { name: data.name.trim() }),
+          ...(data.address && { address: data.address.trim() }),
+          ...(data.timezone && { timezone: data.timezone.trim() }),
+          ...(data.slotLengthMinutes !== undefined && { slotLengthMinutes: data.slotLengthMinutes }),
+        },
+        include: {
+          docks: true,
+          operatingHours: true,
+        },
+      });
+
+      if (data.slotLengthMinutes !== undefined) {
+        await tx.operatingHour.updateMany({
+          where: { warehouseId },
+          data: {
+            slotLengthMinutes: data.slotLengthMinutes,
+          },
+        });
+      }
+
+      return updated;
+    });
+
+    return result;
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';

import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

import { OrganizationType, UserRole, DockStatus } from '@prisma/client';

describe('Warehouse Settings Update & Slot Length Safeguarding Integration Tests', () => {
  let warehouseOrgAId: number;
  let warehouseAdminAToken: string;
  let dockManagerAToken: string;

  let warehouseOrgBId: number;
  let warehouseAdminBToken: string;

  let testWarehouseId: number;
  let testDockId: number;

  let carrierOrgId: number;
  let dispatcherToken: string;

  const targetDate = '2026-11-20';
  // 60-minute slot: 04:30 to 05:30 UTC (10:00 to 11:00 Asia/Colombo)
  const slot60Start = '2026-11-20T04:30:00.000Z';
  const slot60End = '2026-11-20T05:30:00.000Z';

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Warehouse Operator Org A & Warehouse Admin A
    const warehouseOrgA = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Warehouse Org A Settings ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,

    const res = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/settings`)

      .send({ slotLengthMinutes: 30 });

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);

  });

  it('rejects slotLengthMinutes update by non-admin roles (strict RBAC)', async () => {
    // Dock Manager attempts to change warehouse slot length
    const resDockManager = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/settings`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerAToken}`)
      .send({ slotLengthMinutes: 30 });

    expect(resDockManager.status).toBe(403);

    const resDispatcher = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/settings`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
      .send({ slotLengthMinutes: 30 });

    expect(resDispatcher.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('rejects invalid slotLengthMinutes increments', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/settings`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
      .send({ slotLengthMinutes: 17 }); // 17 is not an allowed increment

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.message).toContain('Invalid slotLengthMinutes');
  });

  it('allows Warehouse Admin to update default slot length to 30 minutes via PATCH /api/warehouses/:id', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
      .send({ slotLengthMinutes: 30 });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.slotLengthMinutes).toBe(30);

    // Verify operating hours were updated to 30 minutes
    const opHours = await prisma.operatingHour.findMany({
      where: { warehouseId: testWarehouseId },
    });
    for (const oh of opHours) {
      expect(oh.slotLengthMinutes).toBe(30);
    }
  });

  it('safeguards existing bookings: original 60-minute booking remains completely unaltered', async () => {
    // Fetch original booking directly from database
    const booking = await prisma.booking.findUnique({
      where: { id: original60MinBookingId },
    });

    expect(booking).not.toBeNull();
    // Start and end timestamps must NOT have shifted or changed
    expect(booking?.slotStartTime.toISOString()).toBe(slot60Start);
    expect(booking?.slotEndTime.toISOString()).toBe(slot60End);
    expect(booking?.status).toBe('BOOKED');
    expect(booking?.truckPlate).toBe('TRK-60MIN-01');
  });

  it('future slot generation engine uses new 30-minute intervals while respecting the existing 60-minute booking', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/slots?date=${targetDate}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);

    const dockSlots = res.body.data[0].slots;
    expect(dockSlots.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Check slot duration of returned free slots: each must be 30 minutes!
    const firstSlot = dockSlots[0];
    const durationMin =
      (new Date(firstSlot.slotEndTime).getTime() - new Date(firstSlot.slotStartTime).getTime()) /
      (60 * 1000);
    expect(durationMin).toBe(30);

    // The existing 60-minute booking covers 04:30 to 05:30 UTC
    // In the new 30-min grid, this spans TWO 30-min slots:
    // Slot A: 04:30 - 05:00
    // Slot B: 05:00 - 05:30
    // BOTH of these slots MUST be filtered out / unavailable!
    const slotA = dockSlots.find((s: any) => s.slotStartTime === '2026-11-20T04:30:00.000Z');
    expect(slotA).toBeUndefined();

    const slotB = dockSlots.find((s: any) => s.slotStartTime === '2026-11-20T05:00:00.000Z');
    expect(slotB).toBeUndefined();

    // The adjacent slot right after the booking (05:30 - 06:00 UTC) MUST be available!
    const slotAfter = dockSlots.find(
      (s: any) => s.slotStartTime === '2026-11-20T05:30:00.000Z'
    );
    expect(slotAfter).toBeDefined();
    expect(slotAfter.slotEndTime).toBe('2026-11-20T06:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('allows creating a new 30-minute booking matching the updated slot length', async () => {
    // Book the slot directly following the original 60-min booking (05:30 - 06:00 UTC)
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/bookings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
      .send({
        dockId: testDockId,
        slotStartTime: '2026-11-20T05:30:00.000Z',
        slotEndTime: '2026-11-20T06:00:00.000Z',
        truckPlate: 'TRK-30MIN-02',
        driverName: 'New 30 Min Driver',
        driverPhone: '+94773332211',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.id).toBeDefined();
  });
});
```

### Summary of Changes

The **Warehouse Settings Update** feature has been implemented, enabling Warehouse Admins to update default slot lengths (e.g., from 60 minutes to 30 or 45 minutes) while **safeguarding existing confirmed bookings**. Existing bookings retain their original time ranges and remain completely unaffected.

---

### Implementation Details

1. **Prisma Schema Update** ([`schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma)):
   - Added `slotLengthMinutes Int @default(30)` to the `Warehouse` model:
     ```prisma
     model Warehouse {
       id                Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
       organizationId    Int
       name              String
       address           String
       timezone          String
       slotLengthMinutes Int      @default(30)
       ...
     }
     ```
   - Synchronized with MySQL via `npx prisma db push` and generated the updated Prisma Client.

2. **Warehouse Settings Service** ([`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts)):
   - **`updateWarehouseSettings`**:
     - **Strict Tenant Isolation**: Ensures the target warehouse belongs to the authenticated admin's organization (`warehouse.organizationId === organizationId`).
     - **Increment Validation**: Validates that `slotLengthMinutes` is a valid positive integer that divides evenly into operating schedules (e.g., `15`, `30`, `45`, `60`, `90`, `120` minutes).
     - **Atomic Synchronization**: Transactionally updates `warehouse.slotLengthMinutes` and synchronizes all `operating_hours` records for that warehouse.

3. **Controller & Route Layer** ([`warehouse.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts) & [`warehouse.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts)):
   - Added [`updateWarehouseSettings`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L160-L205) controller method.
   - Exposed endpoints:
     - `PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId`
     - `PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/settings`
   - Protected strictly by `authMiddleware`, `requireVerifiedEmail`, and `authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN'])`.

4. **Safeguarding Existing Bookings**:
   - `Booking` records store immutable, explicit timestamps (`slotStartTime` and `slotEndTime`). Updating the warehouse grid configuration does **not** shift, alter, or delete existing bookings.
   - The [`getAvailableSlots`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L430-L545) engine uses the updated slot length for future interval generation, and its interval overlap check (`bStart < slotEndMs && bEnd > slotStartMs`) ensures existing bookings correctly block all overlapping intervals on the new grid (e.g., an existing 60-minute booking automatically blocks two adjacent 30-minute intervals).

```typescript
import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';

export interface WebhookLogEntry {
  id: string;
  receivedAt: string;
  body: any;
  deliveryAttempt: number;
  isDuplicate: boolean;
  key: string;
}

export interface MockCarrierConfig {
  isEnabled: boolean;
  minDelayMs: number;
  maxDelayMs: number;
  failRate: number;
  hangRate: number;
  hangDurationMs: number;
  simulateChaos: boolean;
}

export function createMockCarrierApp(initialConfig?: Partial<MockCarrierConfig>) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(cors());
  app.use(express.json());

  // In-memory control state and logs
  const config: MockCarrierConfig = {
    isEnabled: true,
    minDelayMs: parseInt(process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_MIN_DELAY || '1000', 10),
    maxDelayMs: parseInt(process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_MAX_DELAY || '5000', 10),
    failRate: parseFloat(process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_FAIL_RATE || '0.20'),
    hangRate: parseFloat(process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_HANG_RATE || '0.05'),
    hangDurationMs: parseInt(process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_HANG_MS || '30000', 10),
    simulateChaos: process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_SIMULATE_CHAOS !== 'false',
    ...initialConfig,
  };

  let logs: WebhookLogEntry[] = [];
  const deliveryCounts = new Map<string, number>();

  function computePayloadKey(body: any): string {
    if (!body) return 'empty';
    if (body.booking?.id && body.eventType) {
      return `booking:${body.booking.id}:event:${body.eventType}`;
    }
    if (body.bookingId && body.eventType) {
      return `booking:${body.bookingId}:event:${body.eventType}`;
    }
    if (body.messageId) {
      return `msg:${body.messageId}`;
    }
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(body);
    } catch {
      return String(body);
    }
  }

  function getRandomInt(min: number, max: number): number {
    return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
  }

  // Health check
  app.get(['/health', '/api/carrier/health'], (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
    res.status(200).json({
      status: 'OK',
      service: 'Mock Carrier Notify API',
      enabled: config.isEnabled,
    });
  });

  // 1. Webhook Endpoint
  app.post(['/notify', '/api/carrier/notify'], async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    // Control State Check: simulate service down
    if (!config.isEnabled) {
      res.status(503).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Service Unavailable: Mock carrier notify service is currently disabled.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const { carrierOrg, booking, eventType, message } = req.body;
    const key = computePayloadKey(req.body);
    const previousDeliveries = deliveryCounts.get(key) || 0;
    deliveryCounts.set(key, previousDeliveries + 1);

    const logEntry: WebhookLogEntry = {
      id: `log-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
      receivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      body: req.body,
      deliveryAttempt: previousDeliveries + 1,
      isDuplicate: previousDeliveries > 0,
      key,
    };
    logs.push(logEntry);

    // Chaos Simulation
    if (config.simulateChaos) {
      const roll = Math.random();

      // Approx 5% Timeout Hangs (hangs for hangDurationMs, e.g. 30s)
      if (roll < config.hangRate) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, config.hangDurationMs));
        res.status(504).json({
          success: false,
          message: 'Gateway Timeout: Mock carrier server hung and timed out.',
        });
        return;
      }

      // Approx 20% HTTP 500 Failures
      if (roll < config.hangRate + config.failRate) {
        const delay = getRandomInt(config.minDelayMs, config.maxDelayMs);
        if (delay > 0) {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
        }
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          message: 'Internal Server Error: Simulated third-party carrier webhook failure.',
        });
        return;
      }

      // Random Latency between 1,000ms and 5,000ms (or configured range)
      const delay = getRandomInt(config.minDelayMs, config.maxDelayMs);
      if (delay > 0) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
      }
    }

    // Success response: HTTP 200 OK
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Notification received successfully by mock carrier.',
      receivedAt: logEntry.receivedAt,
      deliveryAttempt: logEntry.deliveryAttempt,
      isDuplicate: logEntry.isDuplicate,
      data: {
        carrierOrg,
        booking,
        eventType,
        message,
      },
    });
  });

  // 2. Control Endpoint
  app.post(['/api/carrier/control', '/carrier/control'], (req: Request, res: Response): void => {
    const {
      enabled,
      simulateChaos,
      minDelayMs,
      maxDelayMs,
      failRate,
      hangRate,
      hangDurationMs,
    } = req.body;

    if (typeof enabled === 'boolean') {
      config.isEnabled = enabled;
    }
    if (typeof simulateChaos === 'boolean') {
      config.simulateChaos = simulateChaos;
    }
    if (typeof minDelayMs === 'number') config.minDelayMs = minDelayMs;
    if (typeof maxDelayMs === 'number') config.maxDelayMs = maxDelayMs;
    if (typeof failRate === 'number') config.failRate = failRate;
    if (typeof hangRate === 'number') config.hangRate = hangRate;
    if (typeof hangDurationMs === 'number') config.hangDurationMs = hangDurationMs;

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: `Mock carrier control state updated. Service is ${config.isEnabled ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'}.`,
      config,
    });
  });

  // 3. Inspection Endpoint - GET Logs
  app.get(['/api/carrier/logs', '/carrier/logs'], (_req: Request, res: Response): void => {
    const duplicatesCount = logs.filter((l) => l.isDuplicate).length;
    const summary: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const [key, count] of deliveryCounts.entries()) {
      summary[key] = count;
    }

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      totalCount: logs.length,
      duplicatesCount,
      uniqueCount: deliveryCounts.size,
      summary,
      logs,
    });
  });

  // 4. Reset Endpoint - DELETE Logs
  app.delete(['/api/carrier/logs', '/carrier/logs'], (_req: Request, res: Response): void => {
    const count = logs.length;
    logs = [];
    deliveryCounts.clear();

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: `Cleared ${count} mock carrier webhook logs.`,
    });
  });

  return { app, config, getLogs: () => logs, getCounts: () => deliveryCounts };
}

export const { app, config } = createMockCarrierApp();
export default app;

const PORT = parseInt(process.env.MOCK_CARRIER_PORT || '4001', 10);

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
  app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`[MockCarrier] Mock Carrier Notify API service running on port ${PORT}`);
    console.log(`[MockCarrier] Webhook endpoint: POST http://localhost:${PORT}/notify`);
    console.log(`[MockCarrier] Control endpoint: POST http://localhost:${PORT}/api/carrier/control`);
    console.log(`[MockCarrier] Logs endpoint:    GET  http://localhost:${PORT}/api/carrier/logs`);
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createMockCarrierApp } from '../src/mock-carrier/server';

describe('Mock Carrier Notify API Service Tests', () => {
  let mockCarrier: ReturnType<typeof createMockCarrierApp>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    // Create fresh instance with fast test defaults
    mockCarrier = createMockCarrierApp({
      isEnabled: true,
      simulateChaos: false,
      minDelayMs: 0,
      maxDelayMs: 0,
    });
  });

  it('responds with 200 OK on health check', async () => {
    const res = await request(mockCarrier.app).get('/health');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.status).toBe('OK');
    expect(res.body.service).toBe('Mock Carrier Notify API');
  });

  it('successfully receives and logs webhook notifications on POST /notify', async () => {
    const payload = {
      carrierOrg: { id: 10, name: 'Swift Haulage' },
      booking: { id: 500, slotStartTime: '2026-11-20T10:00:00.000Z' },
      eventType: 'BOOKING_CONFIRMED',
      message: 'Your dock slot has been booked successfully.',
    };

    const res = await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/notify')
      .send(payload);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.deliveryAttempt).toBe(1);
    expect(res.body.isDuplicate).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.data.eventType).toBe('BOOKING_CONFIRMED');

    // Inspect logs
    const logsRes = await request(mockCarrier.app).get('/api/carrier/logs');
    expect(logsRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(logsRes.body.totalCount).toBe(1);
    expect(logsRes.body.duplicatesCount).toBe(0);
    expect(logsRes.body.logs[0].body.eventType).toBe('BOOKING_CONFIRMED');
  });

  it('tracks duplicate deliveries caused by mobile/network retries', async () => {
    const payload = {
      carrierOrg: { id: 10, name: 'Swift Haulage' },
      booking: { id: 501, slotStartTime: '2026-11-20T11:00:00.000Z' },
      eventType: 'BOOKING_CONFIRMED',
      message: 'Duplicate retry simulation',
    };

    // First delivery attempt
    const res1 = await request(mockCarrier.app).post('/notify').send(payload);
    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res1.body.isDuplicate).toBe(false);
    expect(res1.body.deliveryAttempt).toBe(1);

    // Second delivery attempt (retry)
    const res2 = await request(mockCarrier.app).post('/notify').send(payload);
    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res2.body.isDuplicate).toBe(true);
    expect(res2.body.deliveryAttempt).toBe(2);

    // Check logs summary
    const logsRes = await request(mockCarrier.app).get('/api/carrier/logs');
    expect(logsRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(logsRes.body.totalCount).toBe(2);
    expect(logsRes.body.duplicatesCount).toBe(1);
    expect(logsRes.body.uniqueCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it('simulates service-down state (503 Service Unavailable) when isEnabled is false', async () => {
    // Disable service via control endpoint
    const controlRes = await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/api/carrier/control')
      .send({ enabled: false });

    expect(controlRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(controlRes.body.config.isEnabled).toBe(false);

    // POST /notify must immediately return 503
    const notifyRes = await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/notify')
      .send({
        carrierOrg: { id: 10 },
        booking: { id: 502 },
        eventType: 'BOOKING_CANCELLED',
        message: 'Cancellation notice',
      });

    expect(notifyRes.status).toBe(503);
    expect(notifyRes.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(notifyRes.body.message).toContain('Service Unavailable');

    // Re-enable service
    await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/api/carrier/control')
      .send({ enabled: true });

    const retryRes = await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/notify')
      .send({
        carrierOrg: { id: 10 },
        booking: { id: 502 },
        eventType: 'BOOKING_CANCELLED',
        message: 'Cancellation notice',
      });

    expect(retryRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(retryRes.body.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('simulates HTTP 500 failures when chaos simulation is triggered', async () => {
    // Configure mock carrier to simulate 100% failure rate with 0ms delay
    await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/api/carrier/control')
      .send({
        simulateChaos: true,
        failRate: 1.0,
        hangRate: 0,
        minDelayMs: 0,
        maxDelayMs: 0,
      });

    const res = await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/notify')
      .send({
        carrierOrg: { id: 10 },
        booking: { id: 503 },
        eventType: 'BOOKING_RESCHEDULED',
        message: 'Reschedule notice',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(500);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.message).toContain('Internal Server Error');
  });

  it('simulates timeout hangs with configurable duration', async () => {
    // Configure mock carrier to hang for 30ms (instead of 30 full seconds) for automated test safety
    await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/api/carrier/control')
      .send({
        simulateChaos: true,
        hangRate: 1.0,
        hangDurationMs: 30,
        minDelayMs: 0,
        maxDelayMs: 0,
      });

    const startTime = Date.now();
    const res = await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/notify')
      .send({
        carrierOrg: { id: 10 },
        booking: { id: 504 },
        eventType: 'BOOKING_RESCHEDULED',
        message: 'Timeout test',
      });

    const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
    expect(elapsed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(25);
    expect(res.status).toBe(504);
    expect(res.body.message).toContain('Gateway Timeout');
  });

  it('clears webhook logs on DELETE /api/carrier/logs', async () => {
    // Send a webhook
    await request(mockCarrier.app)
      .post('/notify')
      .send({ bookingId: 999, eventType: 'TEST', message: 'Before clear' });

    let logsRes = await request(mockCarrier.app).get('/api/carrier/logs');
    expect(logsRes.body.totalCount).toBe(1);

    // Clear logs
    const deleteRes = await request(mockCarrier.app).delete('/api/carrier/logs');
    expect(deleteRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(deleteRes.body.success).toBe(true);

    logsRes = await request(mockCarrier.app).get('/api/carrier/logs');
    expect(logsRes.body.totalCount).toBe(0);
    expect(logsRes.body.duplicatesCount).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

### Summary of Changes

The standalone **Mock Carrier Notify API** service has been implemented in [`backend/src/mock-carrier/server.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/mock-carrier/server.ts) to simulate unreliable third-party carrier webhook deliveries, network latency, random failures, timeouts, and duplicate delivery tracking.

---

### Implementation Details

1. **Mock Carrier Service Server** ([`server.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/mock-carrier/server.ts)):
   - Configured an Express service running on a dedicated port (`PORT 4001` or `MOCK_CARRIER_PORT`).
   - Maintains an in-memory control state (`isEnabled = true`) to simulate service uptime and downtime.

2. **Webhook Endpoint (`POST /notify`)**:
   - **Payload**: Accepts JSON containing `carrierOrg`, `booking`, `eventType`, and `message`.
   - **Control State Check**: If `isEnabled === false`, immediately returns `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable`.
   - **Duplicate Tracking & Logging**: Records every incoming webhook in an in-memory log, calculating payload keys to detect duplicate deliveries caused by mobile or network retries (`isDuplicate: boolean`, `deliveryAttempt: number`).
   - **Random Latency**: Applies a 1,000ms to 5,000ms delay before responding to normal requests.
   - **Random 500 Failures**: Fails approximately 20% of calls with `HTTP 500 Internal Server Error` (`Math.random() < 0.20`).
   - **Timeout Hangs**: Hangs for approximately 5% of calls (default 30 seconds, configurable via environment variable or control endpoint so automated tests don't stall).
   - **Success Response**: Returns `HTTP 200 OK` with delivery metadata.

3. **Control & Inspection Endpoints**:
   - `POST /api/carrier/control`: Body `{ enabled: boolean }` toggles the mock service on/off. Also allows configuring chaos parameters (`simulateChaos`, `failRate`, `hangRate`, `hangDurationMs`, `minDelayMs`, `maxDelayMs`).
   - `GET /api/carrier/logs`: Returns total requests received, duplicate count, unique deliveries count, summary breakdown, and chronological logs.
   - `DELETE /api/carrier/logs`: Clears all recorded webhook logs and resets delivery counters between test runs.

4. **NPM Integration Script** ([`package.json`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/package.json)):
   - Added `"start:mock-carrier": "ts-node src/mock-carrier/server.ts"` to run the mock carrier service independently or alongside the main backend.

```typescript
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';
import { emailService } from './email.service';

export interface InviteUserInput {
  email: string;
}

export interface RequesterContext {
  userId: number;
  organizationId: number;
  role: string;
}

export interface InvitedUserDTO {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  role: UserRole;
  organizationId: number;
  isActive: boolean;
  isEmailVerified: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  organization?: {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    type: string;
  };
}

export interface InviteUserResponse {
  user: InvitedUserDTO;
  message: string;
}

export class UserService {
  /**
   * Invite a new user to the requester's organization.
   * Restricts role assignment strictly based on the requester's admin type:
   * - CARRIER_ADMIN -> DISPATCHER (Carrier Organization)
   * - WAREHOUSE_ADMIN -> DOCK_MANAGER (Warehouse Operator Organization)
   */
  public async inviteUser(
    requester: RequesterContext,
    input: InviteUserInput
  ): Promise<InviteUserResponse> {
    const { email } = input;

    // Validate email presence and format
    if (!email || typeof email !== 'string') {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'A valid email address is required.' };
    }

    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(normalizedEmail)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid email address format.' };
    }

    // Determine target role strictly by requester role
    let targetRole: UserRole;
    if (requester.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN') {
      targetRole = UserRole.DISPATCHER;
    } else if (requester.role === 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN') {
      targetRole = UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER;
    } else {
      throw {
        status: 403,
        message: `Forbidden. Role '${requester.role}' cannot invite users. Only CARRIER_ADMIN and WAREHOUSE_ADMIN are authorized.`,
      };
    }

    // Verify requester organization exists
    const organization = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: requester.organizationId },
    });

    if (!organization) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Requester organization not found.' };
    }

    // Check if user already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    // Generate random secure temporary [REDACTED:generic-password] and hash it
    const temporaryPassword = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash(temporaryPassword, securityConfig.saltRounds);

    // Generate verification/invitation token
    const verificationToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

    // Create user record linked to requester's organization
    const newUser = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: normalizedEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
        role: targetRole,
        organizationId: requester.organizationId,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: false,
        verificationToken,
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        organizationId: true,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
        createdAt: true,
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    // Dispatch invitation email asynchronously
    emailService
      .sendInvitationEmail(newUser.email, organization.name, targetRole, verificationToken)
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('[UserService] Failed to dispatch invitation email:', err);
      });

    return {
      user: newUser,
      message: `Invitation successfully sent to ${newUser.email} as ${targetRole}.`,
    };
  }
}

export const userService = new UserService();
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { userService } from '../services/user.service';

export const inviteUser = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Authentication required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    // Only accept email field from request body
    const { email } = req.body;

    const result = await userService.inviteUser(
      {
        userId: req.user.userId,
        organizationId: req.user.organizationId,
        role: req.user.role,
      },
      { email }
    );

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
      data: result.user,
      user: result.user,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred while inviting the user.',
    });
  }
};

```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

describe('Organization Registration & Role-based User Invitation Tests', () => {
  let carrierAdminToken: string;
  let carrierAdminId: number;
  let carrierOrgId: number;

  let warehouseAdminToken: string;
  let warehouseAdminId: number;
  let warehouseOrgId: number;

  let dispatcherToken: string;
  let dockManagerToken: string;

  const testTimestamp = Date.now();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Create a Carrier Admin with Organization
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Swift Logistics Corp ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const carrierAdmin = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `carrier_admin_${testTimestamp}@swiftlogistics.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    carrierAdminId = carrierAdmin.id;
    carrierAdminToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: carrierAdmin.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: carrierAdmin.role,
        email: carrierAdmin.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 2. Create a Warehouse Admin with Organization
    const warehouseOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Apex Storage Facility ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgId = warehouseOrg.id;

    const warehouseAdmin = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        email: `wh_admin_${testTimestamp}@apexstorage.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminId = warehouseAdmin.id;
    warehouseAdminToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: warehouseAdmin.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        role: warehouseAdmin.role,
        email: warehouseAdmin.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 3. Create regular DISPATCHER and DOCK_MANAGER tokens for negative authorization tests
    const dispatcher = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `dispatcher_test_${testTimestamp}@swiftlogistics.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dispatcher.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: dispatcher.role,
        email: dispatcher.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    const dockManager = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        email: `manager_test_${testTimestamp}@apexstorage.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dockManagerToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dockManager.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        role: dockManager.role,
        email: dockManager.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    // Clean up created test organizations and cascade delete test users
    await prisma.organization.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: [carrierOrgId, warehouseOrgId] },
      },
    });
  });

  describe('Part 1: Registration with Automatic Organization Creation (POST /api/auth/register)', () => {
    it('should register a new Carrier and assign CARRIER_ADMIN role', async () => {
      const email = `reg_carrier_${Date.now()}@carrier-freight.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          organizationName: 'Global Freight Carriers',
          organizationType: 'CARRIER',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.token).toBeDefined();

      const user = res.body.data?.user || res.body.user;
      expect(user).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.email).toBe(email);
      expect(user.role).toBe(UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN);
      expect(user.organizationId).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.organization?.name).toBe('Global Freight Carriers');
      expect(user.organization?.type).toBe(OrganizationType.CARRIER);

      // Clean up newly created org
      await prisma.organization.delete({
        where: { id: user.organizationId },
      });
    });

    it('should register a new Warehouse Operator with orgName/orgType aliases and assign WAREHOUSE_ADMIN role', async () => {
      const email = `reg_wh_${Date.now()}@colombo-yard.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          orgName: 'Colombo Metro Yard',
          orgType: 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.token).toBeDefined();

      const user = res.body.data?.user || res.body.user;
      expect(user).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.email).toBe(email);
      expect(user.role).toBe(UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN);
      expect(user.organizationId).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.organization?.name).toBe('Colombo Metro Yard');
      expect(user.organization?.type).toBe(OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR);

      // Clean up newly created org
      await prisma.organization.delete({
        where: { id: user.organizationId },
      });
    });

    it('should reject registration if email is already taken', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email: `carrier_admin_${testTimestamp}@swiftlogistics.com`,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          organizationName: 'Duplicate Carrier',
          organizationType: 'CARRIER',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(409);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/already exists/i);
    });

    it('should reject registration with invalid organization type', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email: `invalid_type_${Date.now()}@example.com`,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          organizationName: 'Unknown Org',
          organizationType: 'INVALID_TYPE',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('Part 2: User Invitation Endpoint (POST /api/users/invite)', () => {
    it('should reject unauthenticated request with 401', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .send({ email: 'unauth@test.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should reject non-admin roles (DISPATCHER) with 403 Forbidden', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
        .send({ email: 'new_subordinate@test.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/not authorized|forbidden/i);
    });

    it('should reject non-admin roles (DOCK_MANAGER) with 403 Forbidden', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerToken}`)
        .send({ email: 'new_subordinate@test.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/not authorized|forbidden/i);
    });

    it('should reject invalid or missing email with 400 Bad Request', async () => {
      const res1 = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`)
        .send({});

      expect(res1.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res1.body.success).toBe(false);

      const res2 = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`)
        .send({ email: 'not-an-email' });

      expect(res2.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res2.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should allow CARRIER_ADMIN to invite a user and automatically assign DISPATCHER role and carrier org', async () => {
      const inviteeEmail = `new_dispatcher_${Date.now()}@swiftlogistics.com`;

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`)
        .send({
          email: inviteeEmail,
          // Attacker attempts to escalate role or change tenant
          role: 'CARRIER_ADMIN',
          organizationId: 999999,
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);

      const user = res.body.data || res.body.user;
      expect(user).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.email).toBe(inviteeEmail);
      expect(user.role).toBe(UserRole.DISPATCHER);
      expect(user.organizationId).toBe(carrierOrgId);
      expect(user.isActive).toBe(true);
      expect(user.isEmailVerified).toBe(false);

      // Verify record directly in database
      const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { email: inviteeEmail },
      });
      expect(dbUser).not.toBeNull();
      expect(dbUser!.role).toBe(UserRole.DISPATCHER);
      expect(dbUser!.organizationId).toBe(carrierOrgId);
      expect(dbUser!.isEmailVerified).toBe(false);
      expect(dbUser!.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash).toBeDefined();
      expect(dbUser!.verificationToken).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('should allow WAREHOUSE_ADMIN to invite a user and automatically assign DOCK_MANAGER role and warehouse org', async () => {
      const inviteeEmail = `new_manager_${Date.now()}@apexstorage.com`;

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminToken}`)
        .send({
          email: inviteeEmail,
          // Attacker attempts to change role
          role: 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);

      const user = res.body.data || res.body.user;
      expect(user).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.email).toBe(inviteeEmail);
      expect(user.role).toBe(UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER);
      expect(user.organizationId).toBe(warehouseOrgId);
      expect(user.isActive).toBe(true);
      expect(user.isEmailVerified).toBe(false);

      // Verify record directly in database
      const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { email: inviteeEmail },
      });
      expect(dbUser).not.toBeNull();
      expect(dbUser!.role).toBe(UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER);
      expect(dbUser!.organizationId).toBe(warehouseOrgId);
      expect(dbUser!.isEmailVerified).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should reject invitation if the email is already registered in the system (409 Conflict)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`)
        .send({ email: `carrier_admin_${testTimestamp}@swiftlogistics.com` });

      expect(res.status).toBe(409);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/already exists/i);
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { emailService } from './email.service';

export interface CreateInvitationInput {
  email: string;
}

export interface RequesterContext {
  userId: number;
  organizationId: number;
  role: string;
}

export interface InvitationResponse {
  invitation: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    organizationId: number;
    role: string;
    token: string;
    expiresAt: Date;
    status: string;
    createdAt: Date;
  };
  message: string;
}

export class InvitationService {
  /**
   * Create or refresh an invitation for a new team member.
   * - Restricted strictly to CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.
   * - CARRIER_ADMIN -> "DISPATCHER"
   * - WAREHOUSE_ADMIN -> "DOCK_MANAGER"
   * - Token expiration: 48 hours
   * - Rejects if email belongs to an existing user (409 Conflict)
   */
  public async createInvitation(
    requester: RequesterContext,
    input: CreateInvitationInput
  ): Promise<InvitationResponse> {
    const { email } = input;

    if (!email || typeof email !== 'string') {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'A valid email address is required.' };
    }

    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(normalizedEmail)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid email address format.' };
    }

    // Role mapping
    let targetRole: string;
    if (requester.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN') {
      targetRole = 'DISPATCHER';
    } else if (requester.role === 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN') {
      targetRole = 'DOCK_MANAGER';
    } else {
      throw {
        status: 403,
        message: `Forbidden. Role '${requester.role}' cannot invite users. Only CARRIER_ADMIN and WAREHOUSE_ADMIN are authorized.`,
      };
    }

    // Check if user already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    // Verify requester organization exists
    const organization = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: requester.organizationId },
    });

    if (!organization) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Requester organization not found.' };
    }

    // Generate secure random token and 48-hour expiration
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 48 hours

    // Upsert invitation record (handles fresh invites and resends)
    const invitation = await prisma.invitation.upsert({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
      create: {
        email: normalizedEmail,
        organizationId: requester.organizationId,
        role: targetRole,
        token,
        expiresAt,
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
      update: {
        organizationId: requester.organizationId,
        role: targetRole,
        token,
        expiresAt,
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });

    // Send invitation email asynchronously
    emailService
      .sendInvitationEmail(normalizedEmail, organization.name, targetRole, token)
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('[InvitationService] Failed to dispatch invitation email:', err);
      });

    return {
      invitation,
      message: `Invitation successfully created for ${normalizedEmail} as ${targetRole}.`,
    };
  }
}

export const invitationService = new InvitationService();

```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { invitationService } from '../services/invitation.service';

export const inviteUser = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Authentication required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    // Accepts only email from request body
    const { email } = req.body;

    const result = await invitationService.createInvitation(
      {
        userId: req.user.userId,
        organizationId: req.user.organizationId,
        role: req.user.role,
      },
      { email }
    );

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
      data: result.invitation,
      invitation: result.invitation,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred while creating the invitation.',
    });
  }
};

```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

describe('Secure Token-Based Invitation & Account Creation Workflow Tests', () => {
  let carrierAdminToken: string;
  let carrierAdminId: number;
  let carrierOrgId: number;

  let warehouseAdminToken: string;
  let warehouseAdminId: number;
  let warehouseOrgId: number;

  let dispatcherToken: string;
  let dockManagerToken: string;

  const testTimestamp = Date.now();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Create a Carrier Admin with Organization
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Swift Logistics Corp ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const carrierAdmin = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `carrier_admin_${testTimestamp}@swiftlogistics.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    carrierAdminId = carrierAdmin.id;
    carrierAdminToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: carrierAdmin.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: carrierAdmin.role,
        email: carrierAdmin.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 2. Create a Warehouse Admin with Organization
    const warehouseOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Apex Storage Facility ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgId = warehouseOrg.id;

    const warehouseAdmin = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        email: `wh_admin_${testTimestamp}@apexstorage.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminId = warehouseAdmin.id;
    warehouseAdminToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: warehouseAdmin.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        role: warehouseAdmin.role,
        email: warehouseAdmin.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 3. Create regular DISPATCHER and DOCK_MANAGER tokens for negative authorization tests
    const dispatcher = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `dispatcher_test_${testTimestamp}@swiftlogistics.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dispatcher.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: dispatcher.role,
        email: dispatcher.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    const dockManager = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        email: `manager_test_${testTimestamp}@apexstorage.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dockManagerToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dockManager.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        role: dockManager.role,
        email: dockManager.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    // Clean up created test organizations and cascade delete test users/invitations
    await prisma.organization.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: [carrierOrgId, warehouseOrgId] },
      },
    });
  });

  describe('Part 1: Registration with Automatic Organization Creation (POST /api/auth/register)', () => {
    it('should register a new Carrier and assign CARRIER_ADMIN role', async () => {
      const email = `reg_carrier_${Date.now()}@carrier-freight.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          organizationName: 'Global Freight Carriers',
          organizationType: 'CARRIER',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.token).toBeDefined();

      const user = res.body.data?.user || res.body.user;
      expect(user).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.email).toBe(email);
      expect(user.role).toBe(UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN);
      expect(user.organizationId).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.organization?.name).toBe('Global Freight Carriers');
      expect(user.organization?.type).toBe(OrganizationType.CARRIER);

      // Clean up newly created org
      await prisma.organization.delete({
        where: { id: user.organizationId },
      });
    });

    it('should register a new Warehouse Operator with orgName/orgType aliases and assign WAREHOUSE_ADMIN role', async () => {
      const email = `reg_wh_${Date.now()}@colombo-yard.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          orgName: 'Colombo Metro Yard',
          orgType: 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.token).toBeDefined();

      const user = res.body.data?.user || res.body.user;
      expect(user).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.email).toBe(email);
      expect(user.role).toBe(UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN);
      expect(user.organizationId).toBeDefined();
      expect(user.organization?.name).toBe('Colombo Metro Yard');
      expect(user.organization?.type).toBe(OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR);

      // Clean up newly created org
      await prisma.organization.delete({
        where: { id: user.organizationId },
      });
    });

    it('should reject registration if email is already taken', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email: `carrier_admin_${testTimestamp}@swiftlogistics.com`,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          organizationName: 'Duplicate Carrier',
          organizationType: 'CARRIER',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(409);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/already exists/i);
    });

    it('should reject registration with invalid organization type', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .send({
          email: `invalid_type_${Date.now()}@example.com`,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
          organizationName: 'Unknown Org',
          organizationType: 'INVALID_TYPE',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('Part 2: Admin Invite Endpoint (POST /api/users/invite)', () => {
    it('should reject unauthenticated request with 401', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .send({ email: 'unauth@test.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should reject non-admin roles (DISPATCHER) with 403 Forbidden', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
        .send({ email: 'new_subordinate@test.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/not authorized|forbidden/i);
    });

    it('should reject non-admin roles (DOCK_MANAGER) with 403 Forbidden', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerToken}`)
        .send({ email: 'new_subordinate@test.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);

        .post('/api/users/invite')

      expect(res2.body.success).toBe(false);

    it('should allow CARRIER_ADMIN to invite a user, automatically saving an Invitation with DISPATCHER role and carrier org', async () => {
      const inviteeEmail = `new_dispatcher_${Date.now()}@swiftlogistics.com`;

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/users/invite')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`)
        .send({
          email: inviteeEmail,
          // Attacker attempts to escalate role or change tenant
          role: 'CARRIER_ADMIN',
          organizationId: 999999,
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);

      const invitation = res.body.data || res.body.invitation;
      expect(invitation).toBeDefined();
      expect(invitation.email).toBe(inviteeEmail);
      expect(invitation.role).toBe('DISPATCHER');
      expect(invitation.organizationId).toBe(carrierOrgId);
      expect(invitation.status).toBe('PENDING');
      expect(invitation.token).toBeDefined();
      expect(invitation.expiresAt).toBeDefined();

      // Verify expiration is roughly 48 hours in the future
      const expiresAt = new Date(invitation.expiresAt).getTime();
      const now = Date.now();
      const diffHours = (expiresAt - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      expect(diffHours).toBeGreaterThan(47);
      expect(diffHours).toBeLessThanOrEqual(48.1);

      // Verify record directly in database
      const dbInvitation = await prisma.invitation.findUnique({
        where: { email: inviteeEmail },
      });
      expect(dbInvitation).not.toBeNull();
      expect(dbInvitation!.role).toBe('DISPATCHER');
      expect(dbInvitation!.organizationId).toBe(carrierOrgId);
      expect(dbInvitation!.status).toBe('PENDING');

      // User account should NOT exist yet in users table
      const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { email: inviteeEmail },
      });
      expect(dbUser).toBeNull();
    });

    it('should allow WAREHOUSE_ADMIN to invite a user, automatically saving an Invitation with DOCK_MANAGER role and warehouse org', async () => {

      expect(dbInvitation!.organizationId).toBe(warehouseOrgId);
      expect(dbInvitation!.status).toBe('PENDING');
```
